newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy wins 75 pct of North Flinders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy wins 75 pct of North Flinders.

text.p: Gold group Normandy Mining Ltd said on Thursday it had 75 percent of North Flinders Mines ltd after the close of its takeover offer on December 18.
Normandy's offer was 425 Normandy shares for every 100 North Flinders shares and was part of a rationalisation which saw Gold Mines of Kalgoorlie Ltd and Posgold Ltd merge with Normandy.

Normandy said on December 11 its takeover bid would not be extended beyond December 18 unless compulsory acquisition thresholds were likely to be reached. Companies need at least 90 percent control to compulsorily acquire remaining stock.
